business_problem: Pentasoft needed an affordable, scalable way to offer near-real-time industrial and oil-and-gas monitoring to SMB customers that could not justify building their own IoT infrastructure, while keeping onboarding simple and application latency low.
solution_summary: Pentasoft built its Neuron and Akron industrial IoT platforms as fully serverless, event-driven SaaS applications on AWS so small and midsize customers can deploy monitoring without managing infrastructure. Physical sensors and petrol-station devices connect through AWS IoT Core, which securely ingests telemetry from industrial equipment, dispensers, tanks, terminals, and price boards. Pentasoft models and organizes industrial data in AWS IoT SiteWise for Neuron, stores high-performance near-real-time device and pricing data in Amazon DynamoDB for Akron, and uses AWS IoT TwinMaker to create digital twins of customer environments. Customer data is surfaced through Amazon QuickSight dashboards so end users can analyze telemetry, competition pricing, and other KPIs in minutes. This architecture lets Pentasoft provision new accounts quickly, scale automatically with demand, and deliver pay-as-you-go IoT analytics with strong availability and low latency.
